english.note: Use this when a situation, emotion, crowd, or action has gone out of control rather than simply being difficult to control.
Use this when the situation has already escaped control, rather than merely being difficult to handle.

examples.english: The situation at the scene became uncontrollable for a while.
examples.jyutping: jin6 coeng4 jat1 dou6 sat1 hung3

examples.english: Once people at the scene started arguing, the whole situation became unmanageable.
examples.traditional: 現場啲人一鬧交，成件事即刻失控。
examples.jyutping: jin6 coeng4 di1 jan4 jat1 naau6 gaau1 sing4 gin6 si6 zik1 hak1 sat1 hung3
